authors: Y. Bugeaud, P. Corvaja, U. Zannier
title: An upper bound for the G.C.D. of a^n - 1 and b^n - 1
quote: Let a,b ∈ Z be multiplicatively independent integers. Then for every ε>0, log gcd(a^n−1, b^n−1) ≤ εn for all but finitely many positive integers n.

title: A lower bound for the height of a rational function at S-unit points
quote: We prove that, for all (u,v) ∈ Γ outside a proper Zariski closed subset of G_m^2, the height of p(u,v)/q(u,v) verifies h(p(u,v)/q(u,v)) > h(1:p(u,v):q(u,v)) − ε max(h(u),h(v)). As a consequence, we deduce upper bounds for (a generalized notion of) the g.c.d. of u−1, v−1 for u,v running over Γ.
note: Two-run words: G | (2^|d1-d2| - 1) gcd(2^{d1L1}-3^{L1}, 2^{d2L2}-3^{L2}) = gcd(u-1,v-1) up to S-units; exceptional set = one run bounded (lever families). Ineffective.

note: Quote from Bilu's Bourbaki survey (fetched); Levin 2019 credits HL with the S-unit gcd(u-1,v-1) bound over Q. Primary not fetched.

title: Greatest common divisors and Vojta's conjecture for blowups of algebraic tori
quote: (a) There exists a finite union Z of translates of proper algebraic subgroups of G_m^n such that N_{gcd,S}(F(u_1,…,u_n),G(u_1,…,u_n)) < ε max{h(u_1),h(u_2),…,h(u_n)} for all (u_1,…,u_n) ∈ G_m^n(O_{k,S}) \ Z.
note: Theorem 1.12(a) as restated in Levin-Wang arXiv:1903.03876 (fetched); primary paywalled. For fixed m runs: G <= e^{eps o} off subtorus families. Ineffective.

title: Generalized greatest common divisors, divisibility sequences, and Vojta's conjecture for blowups

note: G = height relative to the codim-2 scheme {S=D=0}; conditional on Vojta.

note: C[T] analogue via Lang's torsion theorem; Layer 1 is closed.

note: The eps-bound fails in char p: the gcd bound is genuinely arithmetic.
